checks.name: Preserved v0.48 source reproduces the unrendered dispatch burst and missing final held endpoint
High-rate coalesced finger samples publish the latest absolute target once per display frame, without keyboard/zoom commands
The final pointer-up position is consumed while middle pan remains held, then releases without losing distance
Pointer cancellation and real blur discard queued pan work and release immediately, with no later ghost movement
Different native frame cadences and many raw samples retain identical full drag distance
Slow display frames batch once, and missing GL context or a stopped native renderer release within the bounded deadline
Capture excursions stay within an offset canvas without wrapping, and ordinary interior motion retains its full distance
A rapid new touch and pagehide cancel pending final release without releasing or moving a later gesture
A normal stationary tap remains one contextual left click and a deliberate long drag remains a left-button box selection
Single-site placement and line-placement keep their own input and never leak orders or camera pans
Pinch remains zoom-only, horizontal two-finger motion pans without zoom, and dropping one finger does not restart a gesture
Minimap drags retain the native right-button path and do not invoke battlefield middle pan
Duel retains its existing immediate one-finger pan; native tap, build, radar, multi-touch, camera and order helpers are unchanged

scope: Actual current touch adapter in a virtual DOM/RAF plus absolute-mouse native-frame input oracle; no real native camera render or touch-screen verification.
